Why do we use Shizuku digital key?
Why can\'t the app enable 120Hz automatically?

In Android, refresh rate management is protected by system security from regular apps. Previously, unlocking it required connecting the phone to a PC with a USB cable and typing commands into a black terminal window.

Shizuku is an official, globally trusted open-source tool (available on Google Play). It connects to Android\'s built-in \'Wireless Debugging\' over Wi-Fi and functions as a secure digital key directly on your phone.
Completely safe. It does not require Root, does not modify firmware, and AdaptiveHz has ZERO internet permissions (0 network packets), keeping all your data 100% private.

Independent analysis of Samsung One UI, panel architectures, and system restrictions

On LTPO flagships (S23/S24 Ultra), the panel natively scales down to 1–24 Hz on static content. Forcing continuous 120 Hz disables hardware VRR savings. AdaptiveHz is best used on LTPO to bypass the 60 Hz lock in One UI Power Saving Mode.
For Galaxy A52/A72, high target frequency is capped to 90 Hz to prevent display controller faults.
Cover display refresh rate is synchronized via sub_refresh_rate_mode in Settings.Secure.
If Accessibility Service is greyed out on sideloaded APK, open App Info → 3-dots menu → \"Allow restricted settings\".
Panel Type: Fixed AMOLED vs LTPO VRR

On non-LTPO devices (S20, S20 FE, S21, A52, A54), One UI does not reduce refresh rate on static content. AdaptiveHz delivers up to +45% battery gains. On LTPO flagships, forcing 120 Hz disables native low-frequency drops.
Resolved: Automated panel architecture detection. LTPO displays receive an optimization advisory, preserving hardware VRR drops.
Galaxy A52 (4G)/A72 hardware is capped at 90 Hz. Forcing 120 Hz crashes the display driver back to 60 Hz. Galaxy S20 series supports an undocumented 96 Hz mode.
Resolved: Dynamic High Target selector (90, 96, 120 Hz) with hardware clamping against Display.supportedModes.
Cover screen and main folding screen are governed by separate system keys (refresh_rate_mode and sub_refresh_rate_mode).
Resolved: Synchronous dual-key updates for sub_refresh_rate_mode during hinge transitions.
When APK is installed outside Google Play, Android greys out Accessibility Service under Restricted Settings.
Resolved: Interactive visual guide showing App Info → 3-dots menu → Allow restricted settings.
One UI 6.0/6.1 DisplayPowerController resets refresh rate to 60 Hz on battery saver state transitions.
Resolved: Reactive broadcast listener on ACTION_POWER_SAVE_MODE_CHANGED with anti-watchdog delayed reassertion.
Samsung Device Care: Background Deep Sleep
Samsung com.samsung.android.lool puts inactive apps into Deep Sleep after 72 hours, stopping touch listeners.
Resolved: Battery optimization exemption request and persistent low-overhead status bar foreground badge.
HyperOS and MIUI require enabling \"USB Debugging (Security settings)\" with an authorized Mi Account and SIM card.
Resolved: Explicit vendor alert modal and instructions for Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO users.
